plan.unanswered: Reduce the measured ordered range reconstruction cost without changing snapshot, full observed-key conflicts, overlays, tombstones or merge priority; prove public read performance effect and preserve small inputs.
commands: scoped in-place cargo-mutants, explicit --lib target and lsm::scan_tests filter
cargo build --offline --locked --profile test -p alopex-server -p alopex-py for before and after

same #776 public query harness, order before/after/after/before/before/after, aggregate/ordered/select-all 34250 rows on both surfaces, ordered 3-row control both surfaces; 48 timed cells, 3warm21measure each; 2 separate after ordered profiles
plan.threshold_reporting: Keep all trial medians/MAD/raw; list every total median regression. Diagnostic noise band=max(5% baseline median,3*baseline sample MAD), not release threshold. No automatic repeats to seek a favorable result.
plan.cleanup: Temporary test dirs owned by RAII and test TMPDIR; per-case DB removed immediately; remove both native packages/binaries/parser/test executables after results and hashes saved; retain compact logs and shared dependencies only
plan.parser: Same pinned public0.8.16 parser as #776, archive SHA8ac1f708efdfdbf6c85a65aebd34a368de41e798d9441a2785abad011cec038d
plan.scope_limit: Internal optimization comparison, not published package/reference acceptance; no change to eager observation semantics or phantom-conflict guarantees

comparison_plan_refinement.reason: The same prefix constructor serves primary-key uniqueness lookup during INSERT; include the original one-row INSERT/rollback case as a write-path constant-cost control before starting any comparisons.
comparison_plan_refinement.identity: supervisor source_sha identifies current harness checkout; before/after native build source is bound separately by server and extension hashes in each ready record

verification.invalid_attempt: core lib test dev dependency builds SQL; parser override was omitted, vendor manifest incompatible with this base. No test executed; corrected to same pinned parser used in native comparison.
verification.invalid_test_compile: Initial test code used borrowed delete keys and non-Arc immutable tables; corrected to actual signatures; kept original compiler log, no tests ran in that attempt.

coupling.summary: 34 modules; C,2 high existing issues. Main-relative report includes prior release changes, not only this patch.
coupling.accepted: Existing LSM-to-MemTable/WAL/transaction coordination is unchanged. Two constructor substitutions introduce no new module/API boundary. SQL range/read paths are validated via public Python embedded/server. No unrelated module refactor in this patch.

mutants_selected: crates/alopex-core/src/lsm/mod.rs:1745:9: replace LsmKV::scan_prefix_visible -> BTreeMap<Key, crate::lsm::memtable::MemTableEntry> with BTreeMap::new()
crates/alopex-core/src/lsm/mod.rs:1829:9: replace LsmKV::scan_range_visible -> BTreeMap<Key, crate::lsm::memtable::MemTableEntry> with BTreeMap::new()
verification.strengthening: Small exact-result/snapshot/conflict tests and 24-case proptest reference model; no new unsafe or arithmetic, Miri/Kani not applicable.

mutation_scope_correction.problem: Installed cargo-mutants included eight unrelated struct-field deletion mutations despite both include and exclude name filters. Stopped owned process, confirmed source hash restored.
mutation_scope_correction.unrelated_result: Original broader attempt contains missed test-config changes; these do not execute in the selected scan-test filter and are not survivors in the changed scan logic. Original logs retained.
mutation_scope_correction.correction: Pre-listed deterministic zero-based slice shard0/3 and asserted its four exact names equal selected-mutants.json before execution. A one-based shard3/3 list attempt was rejected before any build; corrected to zero-based0/3.

automatic.unviable_reason: Whole-function empty map replacements leave prefix/start/end/read_timestamp unused under -D warnings; this is not a behavior-level catch.

erase only active entries after evaluating original snapshot scan; retain immutable/SST merge
